_help: How each Tosca execution list is shown on the dashboard.
Key = execution list name exactly as in Tosca.
project     = group shown as a card (RISE_INDIA, ROW, ...).
module      = SAP module code (QM, MM, PM, PP, SD, ...).
environment = where it ran (QA, SIT, PROD). Lists not listed here use default_environment.
renamed_from = old list names; their history and duplicate check carry over to this list.
Adding a list: add a block here AND in tosca/GetResults.tcs.
